source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930, p. 11 ("COUNTY DOWN: Few Contests in Rural Council Divisions. THE LIST OF NOMINATIONS")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division (Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930)

note: Triennial election of Down County Council on the 20 single-member county electoral divisions; nominations received by R. J. Dickson at Downpatrick. No poll: the only division with two nominations was Downpatrick, and W. J. Halfpenny withdrew there on 8 May 1930, so all twenty were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 2 and 9 May 1930). No party labels are printed, so none are given. Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
